# Local Rekor verification fixtures

These files were generated locally for the EA-306 offline verifier-path tests. The two text tag objects use separate fictional code-signing leaf certificates, one fictional CA certificate in PEM text, and isolated one-entry Rekor logs. They are not gitsign-produced signatures and do not establish Sigstore production-root trust. The tags carry distinct artifacts, CMS signatures, certificates and Rekor entries. Tests exercise CMS extraction, Bundle construction, successful SET, inclusion, checkpoint, certificate-chain, artifact and signature verification against a test-only root. Mutation tests change integrated time, SET and inclusion proof, substitute the second valid tag's entry, and replace the test root's Rekor key to verify fail-closed results.
